reviews.text: We went to Emmi pet for teeth cleaning and again a very good experience. My senior dog received gentle and professional care. We will definitely come again.

Very happy with my dog's grooming - calm and experienced groomer! and we tried a dog massage for my 12 year old dog and the dog masseur was also gentle and professional. We will definitely come again. Big thanks!
Very helpful and kind staff, strongly recommend for a daycare!
Visited the place today with our Suomenlapinkoira for undercoat wash 🐶 Great service with reasonable price. Will come back again! …

The cats are left alone at night in relatively small cages. The barking of the daycare dogs clearly belongs to the space where the cats are housed on the store side. The store also has customers. If your cat is at all stressed, definitely find a home daycare or a vet to come to your home.

If you want a super wonderful treatment for your dog, come to Olga (Raukola) at Tassumafia. I have been to the same place before, but not this Olga. Olga Raukola took me along for the grooming and I was able to be with my old, clipped dog the entire time. The gentleness with which the groomer treated my dog, absolutely unprecedented ❤️Highly recommended Olga Raukola, you are the best!
If you want an uneven trim, go here. Otherwise, it's worth going elsewhere.
